topic: Turn customer reviews into FAQ answers with one prompt
promise: Paste your reviews, get a ready FAQ section
title: Your reviews already wrote your FAQ

hook.say: Your reviews already wrote your FAQ.

scenes.say: Customers keep asking the same questions, and the answers already sit in your reviews.
scenes.visual_hint: one bold line on the brand background

scenes.say: Step one: export your latest reviews into one plain text file.
scenes.visual_hint: three steps land one by one

scenes.say: Step two: paste them into this prompt and ask for the top questions with short answers.
scenes.prompt: From these reviews, list the questions buyers ask most. Answer each in 2 sentences, using only facts from the reviews.
scenes.visual_hint: the prompt types itself in an app window

scenes.say: But the last step is the one that makes buyers trust it.
scenes.visual_prompt: a shield closes around a short answer card

scenes.say: Quote one real review under each answer, so every claim has proof.
scenes.visual_hint: boxes tick as they are spoken

scenes.say: On our test shop, it took only two minutes for fifty reviews.
scenes.visual_prompt: the inbox empties while an FAQ list fills up

cta.say: Get the prompt in our Telegram Lab.

hooks_alt.say: Stop writing your FAQ from scratch.
Same five questions in your inbox again?

facts_used.claim: On our test shop, it took only two minutes for fifty reviews.

notes_vi: Video ~40s: dùng đánh giá của khách viết FAQ bằng 1 prompt; số liệu lấy từ FACTS#1.
